subject: general
question: The region of Ganga Brahmaputra basin lies in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10°N to 30°N latitude**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The region of the **Ganga Brahmaputra Basin** lies in **10°N to 30°N latitude**.
 
• The Ganga Brahmaputra Basin is located in the** subtropical regions** of the** Indian subcontinent**.
 
• The **Ganga Brahmaputra Basin** is the basin created by the** Ganga and Brahmaputra rivers and their tributaries**.
 
• 
 
The** key characteristics** of this basin are its **rich plains, the Himalayas, and the Sunderbans delta**.

 
 
• 
 
The annual monsoon season, which brings rain from **June to September**, replenishes this area as well with its **torrential downpours**. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
A **river basin** is a** geographical region that is drained by a river and its tributaries**. Eventually, the water that has been drained **produces a bay, river, lake, or any other form of water body**.

 
 
• 
 
For the **purposes of developing and planning for water resources**, **river basins** are considered to be the **primary hydrological unit**.

 
 
• 
 
There are **12 primary river basins** and they are, the **Brahmaputra River Basin, Ganga River Basin, Cauvery River Basin, Indus River Basin, Krishna River Basin, Godavari River Basin, Mandovizuari River Basin, Mahanadi River Basin, Narmada River Basin, Tapi River Basin, Mahi River Basin, and Pamba River Basin**.

 
 
• 
 
The **catchment area of each river** is at least **20,000 square km** and the catchment area for these** rivers as a whole** is **25.3 lakh square km**.
